plugin.name: Incus
plugin.description: Incus containers and VMs on your hosts over SSH: usage, processes, logs, a shell and actions, with per-host levels and secret values kept out of view.

tab.title: Incus
tab.noHost: Open Incus from a host that has it turned on.
tab.unreachable: Incus didn't answer on this host
tab.error: Couldn't reach the Incus plugin's server side.

read.title: See Incus instances
read.description: See instances on hosts with Incus turned on: usage, processes, logs and details with secret values hidden.

operate.title: Operate Incus instances
operate.description: Start, stop, restart, freeze and snapshot instances on hosts that allow it. Includes everything See Incus instances allows. Termix's own actions (palette, automations) check this permission by name.

shell.title: Open shells in Incus instances
shell.description: A root shell inside instances, on hosts that allow it. Separate from the others on purpose: a shell can read everything an instance holds, secrets included.

manage.title: Manage Incus instances
manage.description: Create, delete, copy and rename instances and edit their config on hosts that allow it. Includes everything Operate allows, in the Incus tab.

enable.label: Incus
enable.description: Show this host's Incus instances. Only admins can change these settings.

level.label: What's allowed
level.description: Each choice includes the ones above it. Read only: instances, processes, logs and details. Read and operate: also start, stop, restart, freeze and snapshot. Read, operate and manage: also create, delete, rename and edit config. People also need the matching permission, and a higher permission includes the lower ones.

protected.label: Protected instances
protected.description: One name per line. These are never stopped, restarted, frozen, restored or deleted from Termix, and get no shell.

allowShell.label: Allow shells
allowShell.description: Let people with the shell permission open a root shell inside instances.

shell.label: Shell to try first
shell.description: An absolute path, such as /bin/zsh. Left empty, NixOS's bash, then /bin/bash, then /bin/sh.

allowReveal.label: Allow revealing hidden values
allowReveal.description: On a Manage host, let people with the manage permission show one hidden config value at a time. Each reveal is in the audit log.

incusCommand.label: How to run incus
incusCommand.description: The host's user must be able to run incus without a password.

pollSeconds.label: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the list refreshes while someone is looking at it.

list.name: Name
list.tasksHint: Processes and their threads, as Incus counts them

processes.no-agent: This VM has no Incus agent, so its processes can't be read.
processes.frozen: The VM is frozen, so its processes can't be read. Unfreeze it first.
processes.paused: Frozen: these processes are paused until you unfreeze it.

logs.no-agent: This VM has no Incus agent, so its logs can't be read.
logs.no-source: This instance has no journal and no console output.
logs.unreadable: This container's console log isn't available to this host's SSH user
logs.unreadableWhy: App containers have no journal, and Incus keeps their console output in a file only root can read. Its API doesn't serve that file yet. Read it on the host as root:
logs.frozen: The instance is frozen. Unfreeze it to read its logs.

details.hiddenHint: Hidden because it may hold a secret. It never leaves the Termix server.

stop.label: Stop
stop.description: It shuts down cleanly, or is stopped after 60 seconds. An instance set to start at boot starts again then, and a config managed elsewhere may start it again too.

restart.label: Restart
restart.description: It shuts down cleanly, or is stopped after 60 seconds, then starts again.

freeze.label: Freeze
freeze.description: Its processes are paused where they are until you unfreeze it. Nothing is lost, but it doesn't answer meanwhile.

snapshot-restore.label: Restore
snapshot-restore.description: The instance goes back to how it was when the snapshot was taken. Everything since is lost.

actions.snapshotHint: Kept for 7 days. On Incus's dir storage driver a snapshot is a full copy of the instance: as much space again, and it can take a while for a large instance.

companion.title: Incus
companion.off: Incus isn't turned on for this host.

card.title: Incus
card.empty: No hosts have Incus turned on.

manage.protected: This instance is protected on this host: its config can be read here but not changed, and it can't be renamed or deleted.

config.title: Config
config.hint: The instance's own config, without what its profiles add. Values shown as <hidden> keep their real value if you leave them as they are.

copy.title: Clone
copy.label: Clone
copy.name: Name of the clone
copy.hint: Makes a new, stopped instance with this one's config, devices and files.
copy.snapshots: Include its snapshots (on dir storage each one is a full copy)
copy.fixedAddress: This instance has a fixed address (ipv4.address or ipv6.address). The clone gets the same one, so change it in the clone's config before starting it.

delete.title: Delete
delete.label: Delete
delete.typeName: Type {{name}} to delete it, with its snapshots.
delete.description: The instance and its snapshots are removed. This can't be undone.
